summary: Per-frame integrator over a float state vector (this), called from sub_4E5AE0. Accumulates rotation this+0x10 from a base value this+0x60 plus a bias this+0x34, then drives the velocity state this+0x30 toward a directional target built from this+0x54 and this+0x58 with gain this+0x6C and convergence factor this+0x70, folding the result into this+0x24. A sign-aware convergence test either steps or predicts-and-resets the state in one frame. If the magnitude of this+0x24 exceeds the 50.265484 threshold, it invokes InterruptDispatch on the value. The wheel/physics attribution comes from the existing analysis and is not independently confirmed.

operations.description: Accumulate rotation: set this+0x10 to this+0x60 + this+0x34 (base rotation plus bias offset); runs unconditionally at entry.
Build the directional delta: this+0x54 +/- this+0x58, with the sign chosen by whether this+0x30 is <= 0.0, then scale it by the gain this+0x6C.
When the scaled delta is exactly zero (zero threshold, backed by flt_59E440), take the simple-integration path with a zero step.

Sign-aware convergence test: using the FPU flag pair from the comparison, check whether this+0x30 is on the near side of -step (this+0x30 < 0.0 || -step <= this+0x30, or the mirrored form); passing the test takes the simple-integration path, otherwise the predict-and-reset path runs.
Simple integration: this+0x24 += this+0x70 * this+0x30, then this+0x30 += step.
Predict-and-reset path: compute the crossing fraction -(this+0x30 / delta), fold fraction * old this+0x30 into this+0x24, snap this+0x30 to 0.0, then recompute the residual gain this+0x70 - fraction.
When |this+0x54| exceeds this+0x58, re-apply a scaled approach velocity: this+0x30 = residual_gain * this+0x6C * (this+0x54 +/- this+0x58, sign selected by this+0x54).

If |this+0x24| exceeds the 50.265484 clamp threshold (PhysicsMinDeltaThreshold/PositionClampMax, backed by dbl_59ED28 and flt_5AD180), invoke InterruptDispatch with the accumulated value and write it back to this+0x24.
